Support

The Royal Game of Ur for iOS and Android. Last updated 25 October 2026.

Need help with The Royal Game of Ur, or found a problem? Write to the address below and you will get a reply.

rgur-support@lumoxia.art

When you write, please include

  • your device (for example iPhone 16, iPad Air or Pixel 9) and its iOS, iPadOS or Android version;
  • the app version (shown in Settings → Apps → Royal Game of Ur);
  • what you did, what you expected and what happened. A screenshot helps.

Common questions

How do I play?

Tap the book icon at the top left of the game for the rules. In short: roll the four dice, move one stone the number shown, land on a rosette for an extra turn, capture an opponent’s stone in the shared middle lane, and be first to bring all seven stones off the board.

Can I play against the computer, or with a friend?

Both. On the first screen choose “Single Player” to play the computer or “2 Players” to share one device.

How do I change the language, sound or boards?

The language button is at the top right. The gear icon opens sound settings, including the shake-to-roll switch. The board button on the first screen lists the eleven board designs.

How do I reset or delete my statistics?

Open Stats from the first screen. “Reset all statistics” clears everything, and you can also delete a single player.

Does the app need an account or internet connection?

No account is needed. The game works offline and collects no data. The App Store or Google Play needs a connection only when you buy or restore the unlock. See the Privacy Policy.

What does the purchase unlock?

One optional, one-time purchase opens every board and every stone colour. Boards and colours also unlock for free as you finish games, so the game is fully playable without paying.

How do I restore my purchase?

Open the purchase screen and tap “Restore purchases”, signed in to the Apple ID or Google account you bought with. This also works after reinstalling the app or on a new device.

Can I get a refund?

Refunds are handled by Apple for App Store purchases and by Google for Google Play purchases. Lumoxia cannot issue them. If something went wrong with the unlock itself, write to us and we will help. Apple: reportaproblem.apple.com. Google: support.google.com/googleplay.
